title: Watch gigantic snow sculptures emerge
description: Artists carve 25-ton snow blocks entirely by hand at the International Snow Sculpture Championships. A quiet weekday visit to finished works offers a slower experience.
teaser: Artists carve 25-ton snow blocks entirely by hand at the International Snow Sculpture Championships.
goodToKnow: Earlier research listed January 23 to February 2, 2027. Confirm dates and prepare for altitude, cold and possibly icy footing.
